title: Modeling Profanity and Hate Speech in Social Media with Semantic Subspaces

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying semantic subspaces for profanity using minimal pairs of profane and neutral terms, projecting word and sentence representations onto these subspaces, and evaluating their presence via zero-shot transfer classification on profanity and hate speech datasets.

Qualitative per-task error analysis of text classified as offensive, revealing that models incorrectly flag neutral tweets as hate speech due to the presence of non-abusive words related to religion, race, and politics.
